name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.

100% Dynamic Theme-Synchronized Gradients: Completely purged hardcoded red/purple colors. All atmospheric background meshes, cards, footers, headers, buttons, and pills dynamically derive exactly from the selected theme or custom hex color.
Hardware-Accelerated Visible Motion Everywhere: Cards, header, and floating footer dock now feature GPU-accelerated rotating and drifting gradient meshes with moving top rim shimmers.
Header Dynamic Glass & Motion: Synchronized the app header with glassmorphism and animated theme mesh drifting in the background.
Battery-Saving Solid AMOLED: Preserved pure pitch-black styling with all gradient layers disabled in Solid AMOLED mode.
Buttery Smooth 60/120 FPS Compositing: Native transform3d animations ensuring zero frame drops or lag across Link Downloader and Search Studio.
